title: Distribution-Free Conformal Prediction for Steel Fatigue Strength: Marginal Validity Is Not Enough
abstract: arXiv:2608.07589v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predicting fatigue failure in steel components experimentally is costly, requiring testing across multiple compositions and processing conditions, spurring research on data-driven prediction models. Studies using the NIMS MatNavi steel fatigue dataset often report high point-prediction accuracy but rely on aggregate error metrics, leaving uncertainty about the reliability of individual predictions and whether accuracy is consistent across the fatigue-strength spectrum. This paper is the first to apply conformal prediction to steel fatigue strength, comparing seven interval-construction methods across 50 independent data splits and distinguishing marginal coverage from coverage within specific sub-regions of the predicted property. A gradient-boosting point model achieves an R^2 of 0.976 +/- 0.009 and a mean absolute error of 18.3 +/- 2.3 MPa. Split-conformal prediction provides valid marginal coverage (0.918) but drops to 0.758

translated_title: 无分布假设的钢疲劳强度保形预测：边际有效性不足
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07589v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：实验上预测钢部件的疲劳失效成本高昂，需要对多种成分和加工条件进行测试，这促使了对数据驱动预测模型的研究。使用NIMS MatNavi钢疲劳数据集的研究通常报告高点的预测精度，但依赖总体误差指标，这使得个体预测的可靠性以及精度在疲劳强度谱上是否一致存在不确定性。本文首次将保形预测应用于钢疲劳强度，比较了50个独立数据分割上的七种区间构建方法，并区分了边际覆盖率和预测属性特定子区域内的覆盖率。梯度提升点模型实现了R^2为0.976±0.009，平均绝对误差为18.3±2.3 MPa。分割保形预测提供了有效的边际覆盖率（0.918），但降至0.758。
tldr: 本文首次将保形预测应用于钢疲劳强度预测，揭示了边际覆盖率不足以确保所有预测区域的可靠性，并指出在特定子区域内覆盖率显著下降。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to apply conformal prediction to steel fatigue strength, revealing that marginal coverage is insufficient for ensuring reliability across all prediction regions, with coverage dropping significantly in specific sub-regions.
